verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken layout. The main photo is shrunk into a small top-centre strip, and the second TRX photo is a tiny sliver cut off at the bottom-left edge. The headline has lost its yellow panel and sits on bare white, and large dead white areas fill the left and top. In A, a stray yellow rectangle with a black bar lands in the middle of the photo next to the woman's arms, an unwanted collision. B's yellow bars hug the photo's right edge, so they read slightly more like a deliberate accent, but they still overlap the image.
